710-728-2961.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, False Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

4247-6754-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Eusocial Engineering triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1999-3139-4613-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
1999-3139-4613-7340.description:
Activate The Great Henge by tapping it, gaining 2 life and adding {G}{G} which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning The Great Henge from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting The Great Henge from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

643-3413-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Human due to Maskwood Nexus, Xathrid Necromancer triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

575-1794-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one black card in hand.
575-1794-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Ruthless Ripper
When Ruthless Ripper dies, Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2292-4067-5003-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
2292-4067-5003-7848.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent
Repeat steps 4 and 5 until you have {4} or more available.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.
2292-4067-5003-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card. If the permanent taps for more than {1}, there can be less graveyards with seven cards in them.

511-817-4050-4365-7803.notablePrerequisites: Brad Boimler has been tapped this turn.
511-817-4050-4365-7803.description:
Activate Fungal Bloom by paying {G}{G}, putting two spore counters on a Fungus you control.
Activate a Fungus by removing two spore counters from it, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Saprolings, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

360-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1409-2079-3099-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

339-677-2438-7730.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3240-5256-6462-7396.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

997-4302-5929.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
997-4302-5929.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1575-5330-5903.description:
Activate Atog by sacrificing an artifact, which is a Food due to Gourmand's Talent.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

1987-3227-4276-7487.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1987-3227-4276-7487.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Scrivener and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Scrivener and Zealous Lorecaster enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-3227-4276-7487.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

64-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Warden of the Eye and exiling Ephemerate.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1796-1824-2530-7349.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1796-1824-2530-7349.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Diamond Mare triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

4907-5256-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4907-5256-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-6968.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

2440-3330-3399-4399.description:
Cast Stormfront Riders by paying {4}{W/P} due to Defiler of Faith.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Mana Echoes and Leyline of Vitality triggers.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders spell. When it enters, it, Mana Echoes and Leyline of Vitality trigger.
Resolve the Leyline of Vitality trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Stormfront Riders trigger, returning it and the Soldier token created in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Stormfront Riders' second ability triggers twice.
Resolve a Stormfront Riders trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat steps 3 through 5 one additional time.
Repeat from step 10 for the remaining trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger from step 6, adding {C} for each Soldier you control.
Repeat.

141-6798-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-6798-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

1987-4423-6650-6700.easyPrerequisites:
You have the initiative.
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4423-6650-6700.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome by tapping them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome.
When Mystic Sanctuary and Sarevok's Tome enters untapped, they trigger.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sarevok's Tome trigger, causing you to take the initiative.
Repeat.

478-804-2821-4324-6745.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
478-804-2821-4324-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
478-804-2821-4324-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Workshop Elders.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U} plus commander tax, if applicable. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

1115-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-1228-2770-5571.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch.
You control an additional nontoken non-Human creature that does not have indestructible or protection from red.
628-1228-2770-5571.description:
Give control of Blightbeetle to an opponent, if needed. Also, give Goblin Sharpshooter deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to the additional creature and destroying it due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Goblin Sharpshooter trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Goblin Sharpshooter trigger, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

997-3951-4192-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
Ashes of the Fallen on the battlefield with "Assassin" chosen.
997-3951-4192-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

575-2438-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-2438-4674.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

1247-2436-5536.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Marwyn and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-2436-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Marwyn's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

575-5231-5918.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing itself, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Yedora triggers, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Activate Thermopod by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Hauntwoods Shrieker by paying {1}{G}, turning Thermopod face-up.
Repeat.

64-957-2665.notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Warden of the Eye.
64-957-2665.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Warden of the Eye.
When the token Warden of the Eye enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2966-3253-4613-4716.notablePrerequisites:
Zopandrel has at least one indestructible counter on it, and at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
You control at least one additional permanent.
2966-3253-4613-4716.description:
Activate Zopandrel using Myojin of Blooming Dawn's ability by removing an indestructible counter from it, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token for each permanent you control.
When the Spirits enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper's second ability triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Zopandrel by paying 4 life and sacrificing two Spirits, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.
If you control at least two additional permanents as the combo starts, this combo nets infinite lifegain and creature tokens.

2034-2035-2523.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gollum, adding {C}{C}.
When Gollum dies, it and Ratadrabik trigger.
Resolve the Ratadrabik trigger, creating a  nonlegendary token copy of Gollum that is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Gollum trigger from step 2, causing the Ring to tempt you, and for the Gollum token to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Repeat.

2988-4740-5206.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 51.
Curse of Bloodletting attached to you.
2988-4740-5206.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, targeting yourself and causing you to gain 100 life due to Purity and Curse of Bloodletting.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying fifty life, dealing fifty damage to any target.
Repeat step 3.

423-511-3510-5015.notablePrerequisites: Either Sporoloth Ancient or Thallid Shell-Dweller has at least three spore counters on it, with the other having at least two spore counters on it.
423-511-3510-5015.description:
Activate either Thallid Shell-Dweller or Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers, putting a spore counter on Thallid Shell-Dweller and Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-2769-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-2769-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Hanweir Garrison as attackers.
Hanweir Garrison triggers, creating two creature tokens
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

784-3492-3609.notablePrerequisites:
Coretapper and SIlas Renn do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Silas Renn.
784-3492-3609.description:
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase, and deal combat damage to an opponent with Silas Renn.
Silas Renn triggers, allowing you to cast Coretapper from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Coretapper from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat each turn.

562-2796.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Cephalid Aristocrat.
Cephalid Aristocrat triggers, causing you to mill two cards.
Repeat.

3756-4222-4644.notablePrerequisites:
Tidewater Minion does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Tidewater Minion.
3756-4222-4644.description:
Activate Izzet Boilerworks by tapping it, adding {U}{R}.
Activate Tidewater Minion's last ability by tapping it, untapping Izzet Boilerworks.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Repeat any number of times.
